tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the devrel.directory unified index of documentation guides, blog posts, directory listings, jobs, and events (including which have an open call for papers). Returns matching results with absolute devrel.directory URLs; event results deep-link to the specific event on the events page.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "directory_stats" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_directory, get_listing, list_jobs, list_events, search_docs · Public sink: directory_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_directory, get_listing, list_jobs, list_events, search_docs · Public sink: directory_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
